title: Aerial View
meta_description: Private Pool Gulf & Seaside Views - Aerial View by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Aerial View by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 81 Cypress Hill Road Details: Aerial View is a luxurious Old Seagrove retreat ideally located next to Seaside. Offering approximately 3,848 square feet of interior living space, this spacious home accommodates up to 14 guests with five bedrooms, four full baths, and two half baths. Designed for gathering, the home features three living areas, soaring 14-foot ceilings, an elevator, a gourmet kitchen with premium appliances, and beautiful third-floor views of the Gulf and Seaside rooftops. Outside, enjoy the private heated pool, expansive deck, and multiple spaces for relaxing after a day along 30A. The neighborhood beach access is just a five-minute stroll away, while the shops, restaurants, and charm of Seaside are only a 90-second walk from the home. With its generous layout and exceptional location, Aerial View provides an ideal setting for families and groups looking to experience the best of Seagrove Beach and Seaside. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 5-Minute Walk -Distance to Seaside: Approximately 90-Second Walk -Parking Spaces: (4) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available -Private Heated Pool: 10’ x 23’* -Elevator -(3) Living Areas -Gulf and Seaside Rooftop Views -Outdoor Deck -Outdoor Shower -Outdoor Gas Grill -Gourmet Kitchen with Sub-Zero, Wolf, and Miele Appliances *Pool heat is available for an additional $60 (pre-tax) per night and must be arranged prior to arrival. *Pool heating is not recommended when ambient temperatures fall below 50 degrees, as the heater may be unable to reach the desired temperature. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 5 Bedrooms / 4 Full Baths / 2 Half Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Gourmet Kitchen / Butler’s Kitchen and Pantry / Living Room / Dining Area -Half Bath Second Floor: -Bedroom 2 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower, Separate Tub, Double Vanity) -Bedroom 3: King Bed and Twin Sleeper with Private Half Bath -Bedroom 4: King Bed and Twin Sleeper with Private Half Bath -Shared Walk-In Shower Between Bedrooms 3 and 4 -Kid’s Den with Queen Sleeper Sofa -Laundry Room Third Floor: -Bedroom 5 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower, Double Vanity) -Media Room -Wet Bar -Half Bath -Large Outdoor Deck Please Note: *On-street parking is not permitted. The home accommodates a maximum of (4) vehicles in the driveway. *The living room fireplace is decorative only and is not available for guest use. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
